@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+import collections
+
+import pytest
+
+from voluptuous import Coerce, ExactSequence, ExactSequenceInvalid, MultipleInvalid, Schema
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fields,values", [(["a"], ("4",)), (["a", "b"], ("4", "9"))])
+def test_exact_sequence_namedtuple_transform(fields, values):
+    Record = collections.namedtuple("Record", fields)
+    data = Record(*values)
+    validator = ExactSequence([Coerce(int)] * len(fields))
+    for validate in (validator, Schema(validator)):
+        result = validate(data)
+        assert type(result) is Record
+        assert result == Record(*(int(value) for value in values))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("factory", [list, tuple])
+def test_exact_sequence_retains_plain_sequence_type(factory):
+    data = factory(["2", "5"])
+    result = Schema(ExactSequence([Coerce(int), Coerce(int)]))(data)
+    assert type(result) is factory
+    assert result == factory([2, 5])
+
+
+def test_exact_sequence_nested_paths_direct_and_embedded():
+    validator = ExactSequence([int, {"a": int, "b": int}])
+    data = [1, {"a": "bad", "b": "bad"}]
+    with pytest.raises(MultipleInvalid) as direct:
+        validator(data)
+    assert {tuple(e.path) for e in direct.value.errors} == {(1, "a"), (1, "b")}
+    with pytest.raises(MultipleInvalid) as wrapped:
+        Schema({"items": validator})({"items": data})
+    assert {tuple(e.path) for e in wrapped.value.errors} == {
+        ("items", 1, "a"), ("items", 1, "b")
+    }
+
+
+def test_exact_sequence_custom_message_stays_at_sequence():
+    validator = ExactSequence([int], msg="bad sequence")
+    with pytest.raises(MultipleInvalid) as caught:
+        Schema({"items": validator})({"items": ["bad"]})
+    assert isinstance(caught.value.errors[0], ExactSequenceInvalid)
+    assert caught.value.errors[0].path == ["items"]
+    assert caught.value.errors[0].msg == "bad sequence"
+
+
+def test_exact_sequence_scalar_position():
+    with pytest.raises(MultipleInvalid) as caught:
+        Schema(ExactSequence([int, int]))([1, "bad"])
+    assert caught.value.errors[0].path == [1]
+
+
+def test_exact_sequence_length_mismatch_preserves_message():
+    with pytest.raises(ExactSequenceInvalid) as caught:
+        ExactSequence([int], msg="wrong size")([])
+    assert caught.value.msg == "wrong size"
